During the [[Republic Dark Age]] an '''arxeum''', a type of [[Arxeum|mobile university]] dedicated to the advancement of military sciences, was constructed by the company [[Industrial Heuristics]] and pressed into the service of the [[Bactranate]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state, in the [[Gazzari system/Legends|Gazzari system]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the arxeum was given to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] as part of a deal that Daiman had negotiated with the Bactranate leader [[Ayanos Bactra]]. However, the arxeum was destroyed shortly afterward by an [[Odionate|Odionite]] [[Death Spiral]] during the [[Battle of Gazzari]].
